_note: First full wiring round for the United Arab Emirates (previously fully virgin — 0 prior rounds). 3 parallel research subagents (institutional/monetary/finance; energy/construction/climate; population/labour/social/tourism), every proposed edge and new-node citation then independently re-fetched and verified by the orchestrating session before minting (WebFetch + WebSearch; one PDF URL recovered via a direct filetype:pdf search after the HTML landing page rendered JS-only). Closed 20 -> 8 isolated. 2 new international/institutional nodes minted (us-fed-iorb, int-irena-renewable-capacity-statistics); wired an existing-but-unused imf-e-gdds node once the e-GDDS-not-SDDS-Plus distinction was confirmed on FCSC's own National Summary Data Page. Patched ae-construction's publisher/url from an unsourced placeholder to FCSC's national-accounts production series once ISIC-classification evidence resolved its real primary source. Two likely-duplicate pairs flagged as 'note' _dropped entries for Thomas's ruling rather than wired twice: ae-oil-production vs ae-oil, and ae-labour-force vs ae-labour (both pairs were BOTH orphans going in, unlike Indonesia's id-energy-balance-detail case where one side was already wired) — the better-evidenced canonical node in each pair was wired this round, the weaker stub left isolated. ae-tourism vs ae-tourism-dubai was investigated and confirmed NOT a duplicate (annual national DET report vs monthly Dubai-specific DET report, different URLs, different cadence, different jurisdiction_level). 17 genuine non-findings logged as _dropped entries below, grouped by cause: empty/stub official pages (FCSC Oil and Gas, FCSC labour-force document page), stale DSBB metadata (population census, EMP00), no citable methodology text found (education, health x2, banking-credit), too-ambiguous institutional listings (GCC-Stat x2), third-party-not-in-corpus sourcing (DMCC->Dubai Customs), a JS-viewer PDF worth a browser-tool retry (DLD Annual Report, deferred not dead), and one too-generic IMF attribution (population).

reports.title: Interest Rate on Reserve Balances (IORB)
reports.description: The interest rate the Federal Reserve pays on reserve balances held by depository institutions; the Fed's primary tool for implementing the FOMC's target range for the federal funds rate. Minted because it is the explicit, named anchor for the CBUAE Base Rate applicable to the Overnight Deposit Facility, per CBUAE's own Base Rate decision releases.
reports.cadence_note: Set alongside FOMC policy decisions (8 scheduled meetings per year); changes when the Committee changes the target range.

reports.title: Renewable Capacity Statistics
reports.description: IRENA's annual global dataset of installed renewable electricity generation capacity by country and technology. IRENA is headquartered in Abu Dhabi; its capacity statistics are the primary international source underlying UAE renewable-capacity reporting (verified: UAE row shows 6,144 MW total renewable capacity in 2024, matching the growth trajectory reported for ae-renewables).

dependencies.basis: CBUAE's own Base Rate decision release explicitly names the US Fed's IORB as the anchor for the Base Rate.

_dropped.why: GCC-Stat's own UAE country page (gccstat.org/en/statistic/economic/ae) lists FCSC's pre-2020 name ('Federal Competitiveness and Statistics Authority') in an unstructured body list of UAE government/economic bodies, with no 'source', 'data provider', or similar attribution label — too ambiguous to satisfy the explicit-citation bar.

CBUAE's 2006 press release 'Establishment of the GCC unified Statistical Center' has an empty/unreadable attached PDF (page metadata says 'Last updated 2021' but the file itself is dated 2006 — likely a stale asset mismatch). GCC-Stat's own UAE country page does not mention CBUAE at all. No qualifying edge found.

FCSC's 'Oil and Gas' page (the primary source behind ae-oil) renders as an empty stub — a bare year-list heading with no body/methodology/sourcing text, confirmed via both plain fetch and rendered-browser inspection. OPEC's own Annual Statistical Bulletin / MOMR PDFs returned HTTP 402 on every attempt. CBUAE's Quarterly Economic Review does source its own oil-production chart to OPEC, and IMF's Article IV report sources its oil chart to 'OPEC, Country Authorities, ... Haver, IMF Staff Calculations' — but neither is itself the FCSC Oil and Gas series, so no direct edge is supportable. (A pre-existing int-opec-momr -> ae-oil-production no-document entry already covers the sibling duplicate node.)

Extensive search (EIA, The National, Wood Mackenzie and others) found no official UAE/FCSC/OPEC document explicitly tying FCSC's oil-and-gas series to the OPEC+ Declaration of Cooperation or the UAE's 2026 OPEC exit — only secondary/trade-press analysis.

DP World's own press materials (2024 Jebel Ali cargo-volume record) give operational throughput figures with no citation of UAE government statistics; DP World's Annual Report PDF is blocked by robots.txt for automated fetch. No FCSC/Ministry of Economy/Dubai Statistics Center document found citing DP World or Jebel Ali as a source, in either direction.

FCSC's labour-force document page renders only a bare year-list title with no methodology text even in-browser. The DSBB e-GDDS metadata page for UAE's Labour Market Indicators (category EMP00) is entirely empty (last touched 2018). Web search surfaced only Abu Dhabi's SCAD (a different, emirate-level agency) methodology document, not FCSC's. No genuine FCSC citation of the ICLS resolution found.

The only population-specific DSBB metadata page (category POP00) is stale (last updated 2013, describing the 1995 census under the pre-FCSC Ministry of Planning) — not usable as current evidence for the 11.3M (2024) FCSC estimate. No current methodology/census-standard citation found.

FCSC's Health Services portal hierarchy (domain code HLH_HS, with real dataflows DF_HEALTH_WORKFORCE, DF_HEALTH_FACILITIES) is confirmed real but carries no methodology text citing WHO Global Health Estimates.
Same FCSC Health Services portal check as above — no methodology text citing ICD-10 found.

No GCC-Stat document found citing FCSC population data specifically (GCC-Stat's regional labour report names FCSC as a labour-statistics source, but no equivalent population-statistics citation was found this round).
No GCC-Stat document found citing FCSC education data.

IMF's 2025 UAE Article IV report states Population: 11.3 million (2024), matching FCSC's figure exactly, but the line is attributed only generically to 'Country authorities' / 'IMF staff estimates and projections' — never explicitly to FCSC by name for the population line specifically (FCSC IS named explicitly elsewhere in the same report, e.g. the External Sector figure, which is why this is close but doesn't clear the explicit-citation bar).

RESOLVED 2026-08-30 (Thomas ruling): confirmed duplicate, merge into ae-oil. Node `ae-oil-production` removed from the corpus. Likely duplicate, needs Thomas's ruling (same pattern as id-energy-balance-detail in the Indonesia round). Exhaustive search (ADNOC corporate/investor site, ADNOC Gas plc IPO prospectus and quarterly filings, general ADNOC statistical-bulletin searches) found no standing ADNOC crude-oil-and-condensate PRODUCTION STATISTICS release distinct from FCSC's 'Oil and Gas' series, which ae-oil already represents. Every verifiable production-data trail (CBUAE's Quarterly Economic Review, IMF's Article IV report, GCC aggregates) traces back to OPEC reporting or a generic 'country authorities' attribution — i.e. the same FCSC/national channel ae-oil already covers. ae-oil-production's current sourcing (publisher 'ADNOC / energy monitoring', url: null) looks like an unverifiable placeholder rather than a real distinct source. Recommend merging ae-oil-production into ae-oil; left deliberately unwired rather than duplicate this round's edges onto both nodes.

RESOLVED 2026-08-30 (Thomas ruling): confirmed duplicate, merge into ae-labour. Node `ae-labour-force` removed from the corpus. Likely duplicate, needs Thomas's ruling (same pattern as id-energy-balance-detail in the Indonesia round). fcsc.gov.ae/uae-stats-document/labor-force/ (ae-labour) links internally to the same FCSC domain code LFS_LF used by uaestat.fcsc.gov.ae's '.Stat Data Explorer' (ae-labour-force): the Data Explorer's 'Labour Force (LFS_LF)' category, with 17 dataflows (Employed/Unemployed/Labour Force by Citizenship, Gender, Age, Economic Activity, Education, Employment Status/Sector/Occupation), matches ae-labour-force's stated description almost verbatim. Recommend merging ae-labour-force into ae-labour; left deliberately unwired rather than duplicate this round's edges onto both nodes.
